sloka: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः ।आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखिता ।। ६.११४.७५ ।।
transliteration: sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ ca tvaṁ gṛhītvā svāṁ gatiṁ gataḥ ।ātmānamanuśocāmi tvadviyogena duḥkhitā ।। 6.114.75 ।।

translations.english: "By this major disaster of yours, the very root has been destroyed. With the extermination of the Rakshasas, the entire Rakshasa clan is orphaned now by your action."
